summary: Update Ray Data's Lance datasink to dynamically inspect the signature of `lance.write_dataset` prior to invocation to prevent `TypeError` when writing datasets with newer versions of Lance.
assumptions: Ray Data's Lance datasink implementation passes `storage_options_provider` when invoking `lance.write_dataset`.
PyLance 6.x (lance 0.6.x+) has removed the `storage_options_provider` parameter from `lance.write_dataset`.

changes.purpose: Dynamically inspect the signature of `lance.write_dataset` prior to invocation.

changes.description: Add unit test to verify compatibility across PyLance versions.
changes.code:
import unittest
from ray.data import write_lance
from inspect import signature

class TestLanceWriteDataset(unittest.TestCase):
  def test_write_lance_without_storage_options_provider(self):
    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
      write_lance(lance.write_dataset, {})
